name: Boys & Girls Club of Greater Salem Summer Camp

description_short: Day camp at the Boys & Girls Club in Salem, NH. Campers rotate through the Club's program areas, outdoor courts and pool, and go on weekly field trips.
swim_waterfront_notes: Campers use the Club's pool. Send a swimsuit and towel every day.
